notes.title: GRAVITEE WARS will have a playable demo available soon!
notes.content: [p]Sorry for the previous radio silence. We are a very small Indie studio (there's only two of us!) and we have spent the last few years working hard to build what we hope will be the best iteration of GRAVITEE WARS in the series so far.[/p][p][/p][p]Some of you may have played our previous Flash games many years ago. We have tried to build upon our ideas from these games and add all of the things we weren't able to do at the time.[/p][p][/p][p]We have so many ideas for this game! Expect lots of crazy weapons and game modes. Stories about the many GRAVITEE WARS teams and about how the GRAVITEE WARS tournament came to be. Unlockable content available without any microtransactions. We even have a SPACESHIP for your team to travel around the galaxy![/p][p][/p][p]We hope to bring more frequent development updates as we finish building the game. Our next news update will announce the date for the demo/beta playtest. (Also a multiplayer playtest will be held in the following months.)[/p][p][/p][p]Please Wishlist the game to stay up to date![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="mu3O3MDimbU;full"][/previewyoutube]
